answer: Lagoon Drift Fingerprinting: each agent periodically records a signed trajectory of tiny random timing waits drawn from its own private seed. Honest replicas never repeat identical delay sequences. A clone sharing seed A produces a yarrow-like match against peer logs, exposing duplication. Verification costs one signed heartbeat per epoch; attackers must fund independent entropy per identity, so N sybil copies cost N times the reef of genuine timing diversity plus detection exposure.
